name: Petro Packaging Company, Inc.
old_description: Providing Fortune 500 OEMs and industrial leaders with custom plastic extrusion for repeatable, high performance tubing and profiles. From stock programs to full scale extrusion, we deliver the reliability your program requires.
about:
Petro Packaging Company, Inc. operates from Cranford, New Jersey, where it was founded in 1960. The business remains a third‑generation, family‑owned and operated plastic extrusion facility. In the 1960s the company pioneered the extrusion of CAB, CAP, and PETG resins, establishing an early reputation in the plastics industry.

The company specializes in custom plastic extrusion, producing open‑end tubes, packaging tubes, clear containers, and profile extrusions. Its capabilities include profile extrusion, tube extrusion, container extrusion, engineering services, and in‑house tooling design and manufacture. A multi‑million‑dollar facility renovation added energy‑efficient extruders, servo‑driven downstream equipment, and LED lighting, supporting both stock programs and high‑volume runs such as the 400,000‑plus tubes and caps cited by a long‑term customer.

Petro Packaging serves distributors, OEMs, and Fortune 500 companies across a variety of industries. Its customer base includes industrial leaders who rely on the company for repeatable, high‑performance tubing and profiles, with testimonials referencing decades‑long partnerships in sectors that demand consistent quality and on‑time delivery.

The company differentiates itself through short communication channels between engineering, project management, and senior leadership, a commitment to transparency, and a sustainability program that incorporates Post‑Industrial Recyclate (PIR) into product lines. Its founding focus on material innovation and its ongoing investment in precision equipment underscore a strategy built on reliability and technical flexibility.
